item.description: The IOPort class is referenced in multiple test cases but is not defined or imported in the _ast.py module. Tests are failing with "NameError: name 'IOPort' is not defined". This affects tests in hdl_ast, hdl_ir, lib_io, and build_res modules.

contract.description: Add the missing IOPort class definition or import to make it available in the hdl._ast module. The class should be accessible to support IO port operations in the HDL IR and AST components.
contract.interface: Ensure IOPort class is properly defined or imported in hdl._ast module
contract.behavior: Class should be available for use in IO-related operations throughout the codebase

item.description: The Design class is missing a fragments attribute that is referenced in multiple test cases. Tests are failing with "'Design' object has no attribute 'fragments'", indicating that the Design class needs to be updated to include this attribute or the code needs to be updated to use the correct attribute name.

contract.description: Update the Design class to either include a fragments attribute or modify the code that accesses it to use the correct attribute name. The fragments attribute should be accessible to support fragment management in the design.
contract.interface: Design class should have a fragments attribute or equivalent functionality
contract.behavior: Support access to fragment information for design management and testing

item.description: Layout objects are not properly handling integer conversion which leads to "TypeError: 'StructLayout' object cannot be interpreted as an integer" errors. This affects multiple tests involving data layout operations and constants.

contract.description: Ensure Layout classes implement proper __int__ method or handle integer conversion appropriately. The classes should support conversion to integer representations when required by the test cases.
contract.interface: Layout classes should support integer conversion operations
contract.behavior: Layout objects should be interpretable as integers in contexts requiring integer values
